annotations.message: Due to capacity constraints, jobs targeting macOS arm64 runners may experience longer queue times.

findings.finding: Native string authoring does not preserve all required identities: hash lookup folds case and DoWrite encodes negative zero as vm_zero.
findings.disposition: Decision 0019 records pinned source and reproduced outputs. Rust keeps the required exact-byte and exact-bit policy; independent streams explicitly expect each author behavior, and native reads preserve Rust output. No existing golden or hash changed.

findings.finding: Dropping a raw replay writer on string decoding errors can replace the primary error with abandonment.
findings.disposition: Explicit adapter rejection before dropping the raw writer preserves primary and secondary errors. Fault/primary-kind tests pass.

findings.finding: Dictionary errors before consuming finish or while patching the ordinal index can discard sorter/cursor cleanup errors.
findings.disposition: Explicitly cancel unconsumed sorter and close the merge cursor, preserving secondary errors before parent cleanup.

findings.finding: Alternating distant spool/mapping offsets on one Store page would cause excessive cache churn.
findings.disposition: Prefetch a fixed root-charged 1024-ID batch. Current raw/zlib cases fit the unchanged one-MiB root and seven-handle cap.

findings.finding: The spool remains borrowed while nested sorted/unsorted operations can invoke parent cleanup, which matters on Windows.
findings.disposition: Metadata owns the shared Store immediately after creation and explicitly closes it before deleting paths, even while the job retains its control. Retryable cleanup tests and Windows CI pass.

limitations: Not M4 OS/RSS/throughput acceptance; task 031 remains pending. M3 smoke is a regression check, not a repeat of the M3 scale run.
Contiguous symbol groups, registered symbol metadata first, domain-set groups before dependents, one symbol group each. Typed-reference/domain/duplicate errors can surface at finish.
Seven configured scratch handles required within the existing cap; current metadata/sort half-shares unchanged. No new dependency, unsafe code, public fresh-bulk relaxation or spill-run format.
Label occurrences plus existing UELs limited to i32::MAX by reused ordinal format. Mapped adapters and later M4 tasks remain pending.
Reported example times are single release-build runs with reused OS cache on the recorded Linux environment, not a comparative throughput benchmark. Charged capacities are not RSS.
Fixed Arc controls use infallible std constructors after control-budget admission; no allocator-OOM recovery promise.
